component.name: DKChatebras
component.summary: Fast, minimal native Linux client for Cerebras chat models

description.p: DKChatebras is a lightweight, performance-first native C17 Linux desktop client that streams responses directly from the Cerebras API without Electron, GTK, Qt, or a WebView.

It renders directly via X11 MIT-SHM and FreeType2, uses lazy-loaded system OpenSSL for TLS, stores API keys via Secret Service with a 0600 file fallback, keeps lazy-loaded local per-chat JSON history, and formats completed responses with native headings, bordered tables, LaTeX math symbols, and fenced code blocks.

Ground-up minimal native C17 rewrite replacing GTK4/libadwaita/libsoup/json-glib/libsecret with direct X11 MIT-SHM + FreeType2 rendering, zero-dependency JSON/Markdown/LaTeX/table engine, and lazy-loaded OpenSSL TLS.
